cards.title: Lyrics in your language
cards.body: Translations show under the lines when the source has them. Tap the source's name to choose another for this song.

cards.title: Never play, everywhere
cards.body: Block a song or an artist from its menu. Radio and the queue skip it, and YouTube Music hears it's not for you.

cards.title: Scrobble and import
cards.body: Send your plays to ListenBrainz or Last.fm, and bring playlists from Spotify, CSV or M3U into Phone playlists.

cards.title: A lighter Riff
cards.body: Everyday playback and all of Encore in the smaller edition. Riff+ adds Automix, the equalizer, Sing and more; About offers it.
